```{r}
#| context: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(DT)
library(scales)
library(shiny)
library(furrr)
library(future)

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

parse_git_datetime <- function(path) {
  stamp <- str_extract(basename(path), "\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}_\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}")
  as.POSIXct(stamp, format = "%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S", tz = "Australia/Adelaide")
}

summarise_performance <- function(df, group_vars) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  df |>
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) |>
    summarise(
      bets = n(),
      total_unders_profit = sum(under_profit, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_unders_stake = sum(under_stake, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_overs_profit = sum(over_profit, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_overs_stake = sum(over_stake, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_arb_profit = sum(total_profit, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_stake = sum(over_stake + under_stake, na.rm = TRUE),
      unders_roi_pct = if_else(total_unders_stake > 0, 100 * total_unders_profit / total_unders_stake, NA_real_),
      overs_roi_pct = if_else(total_overs_stake > 0, 100 * total_overs_profit / total_overs_stake, NA_real_),
      arb_roi_pct = if_else(total_stake > 0, 100 * total_arb_profit / total_stake, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Load top-down snapshots from history
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
history_files <- list.files("../Data/all_arbs_history", pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(history_files) == 0) {
  stop("No .rds files found in ../Data/all_arbs_history")
}

read_history_file <- function(f) {
  df <- read_rds(f)
  df$git_datetime <- parse_git_datetime(f)
  df
}

combined <- {
  workers <- max(1L, as.integer(future::availableCores()) - 1L)
  if (length(history_files) > 1 && workers > 1) {
    old_plan <- future::plan()
    on.exit(future::plan(old_plan), add = TRUE)

    tryCatch({
      future::plan(future::multicore, workers = workers)
      furrr::future_map_dfr(history_files, read_history_file, .progress = FALSE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      purrr::map_dfr(history_files, read_history_file)
    })
  } else {
    purrr::map_dfr(history_files, read_history_file)
  }
}

combined_sb <- combined |>
  filter(over_agency == "Sportsbet" | under_agency == "Sportsbet") |>
  filter(hour(git_datetime) >= 8 & hour(git_datetime) < 14) |>
  mutate(game_date = as_date(git_datetime)) |>
  filter(margin > 0)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Load results and resolve outcomes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
all_results <- read_csv("../Data/all_player_stats_2025-2026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(firstName, familyName, GAME_DATE, HOME_TEAM, AWAY_TEAM, points, assists, blocks, steals, threePointersMade, reboundsTotal) |>
  mutate(
    player_name = paste(firstName, familyName),
    GAME_DATE = as_date(GAME_DATE) + 1,
    PRA = points + reboundsTotal + assists
  )

analysis_data <- combined_sb |>
  left_join(all_results, by = c("player_name", "game_date" = "GAME_DATE")) |>
  mutate(
    actual_stat = case_match(
      market_name,
      "Player Points" ~ points,
      "Player Assists" ~ assists,
      "Player Rebounds" ~ reboundsTotal,
      "Player Blocks" ~ blocks,
      "Player Steals" ~ steals,
      "Player Threes" ~ threePointersMade,
      "Player PRAs" ~ PRA,
      .default = NA_real_
    ),
    outcome = case_when(
      actual_stat > line ~ "over",
      actual_stat < line ~ "under",
      actual_stat == line ~ "push"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(outcome)) |>
  distinct(match, game_date, market_name, player_name, line, over_agency, under_agency, actual_stat, outcome, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    over_stake = 100 * under_price / (over_price + under_price),
    under_stake = 100 * over_price / (over_price + under_price),
    over_profit = case_when(
      outcome == "over" ~ over_stake * (over_price - 1),
      outcome == "under" ~ -over_stake,
      outcome == "push" ~ 0
    ),
    under_profit = case_when(
      outcome == "under" ~ under_stake * (under_price - 1),
      outcome == "over" ~ -under_stake,
      outcome == "push" ~ 0
    ),
    total_profit = over_profit + under_profit
  ) |>
  filter(over_agency != under_agency) |>
  filter(over_agency != "Dabble Pickem", under_agency != "Dabble Pickem") |>
  mutate(
    agency_combo = paste(over_agency, "vs", under_agency),
    market_name = as.character(market_name)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(game_date), desc(margin))

if (nrow(analysis_data) == 0) {
  stop("No rows available for analysis after joins/filters. Check source data in ../Data/all_arbs_history and ../Data/all_player_stats_2025-2026.csv")
}

date_min <- min(analysis_data$game_date, na.rm = TRUE)
date_max <- max(analysis_data$game_date, na.rm = TRUE)
default_date_from <- as_date("2025-10-01")
date_input_min <- min(default_date_from, date_min, na.rm = TRUE)

all_markets <- analysis_data |>
  distinct(market_name) |>
  arrange(market_name) |>
  pull(market_name)

all_agencies <- sort(unique(c(analysis_data$over_agency, analysis_data$under_agency)))
```

## {.sidebar}

### Filters

```{r}
dateInput(
  inputId = "date_from",
  label = "Game Date From",
  value = format(default_date_from, "%Y-%m-%d"),
  min = format(date_input_min, "%Y-%m-%d"),
  max = format(date_max, "%Y-%m-%d")
)

dateInput(
  inputId = "date_to",
  label = "Game Date To (optional)",
  value = NULL,
  min = format(date_input_min, "%Y-%m-%d"),
  max = format(date_max, "%Y-%m-%d")
)

selectizeInput(
  inputId = "over_agencies",
  label = "Over Agency",
  choices = all_agencies,
  selected = all_agencies,
  multiple = TRUE,
  options = list(placeholder = "Select over agencies")
)

selectizeInput(
  inputId = "under_agencies",
  label = "Under Agency",
  choices = all_agencies,
  selected = all_agencies,
  multiple = TRUE,
  options = list(placeholder = "Select under agencies")
)

selectizeInput(
  inputId = "market_name",
  label = "Market",
  choices = all_markets,
  selected = all_markets,
  multiple = TRUE,
  options = list(placeholder = "Select markets")
)

numericInput(
  inputId = "margin_lower",
  label = "Margin Lower",
  value = 0,
  step = 0.1
)

numericInput(
  inputId = "margin_upper",
  label = "Margin Upper",
  value = 10,
  step = 0.1
)
```

```{r}
filtered_data <- reactive({
  req(input$date_from, input$over_agencies, input$under_agencies, input$market_name)

  margin_lower <- if (is.null(input$margin_lower) || is.na(input$margin_lower)) 0 else input$margin_lower
  margin_upper <- if (is.null(input$margin_upper) || is.na(input$margin_upper)) 10 else input$margin_upper
  if (margin_lower > margin_upper) {
    tmp <- margin_lower
    margin_lower <- margin_upper
    margin_upper <- tmp
  }

  date_to <- input$date_to
  if (!is.null(date_to) && !is.na(date_to) && date_to < input$date_from) {
    date_to <- input$date_from
  }

  df <- analysis_data |>
    filter(game_date >= input$date_from) |>
    filter(over_agency %in% input$over_agencies) |>
    filter(under_agency %in% input$under_agencies) |>
    filter(market_name %in% input$market_name)

  if (!is.null(date_to) && !is.na(date_to)) {
    df <- df |> filter(game_date <= date_to)
  }

  df |>
    filter(margin >= margin_lower, margin <= margin_upper)
})

summary_stats <- reactive({
  df <- filtered_data()
  tibble(
    Metric = c("Bets", "Total Stake", "Total Profit", "ROI %"),
    Value = c(
      comma(nrow(df)),
      dollar(sum(df$over_stake + df$under_stake, na.rm = TRUE)),
      dollar(sum(df$total_profit, na.rm = TRUE)),
      number(
        ifelse(sum(df$over_stake + df$under_stake, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
               100 * sum(df$total_profit, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(df$over_stake + df$under_stake, na.rm = TRUE),
               NA_real_),
        accuracy = 0.01
      )
    )
  )
})

performance_by_date <- reactive({
  summarise_performance(filtered_data(), "game_date") |>
    arrange(desc(game_date))
})

performance_by_combo <- reactive({
  summarise_performance(filtered_data(), c("over_agency", "under_agency")) |>
    mutate(agency_combo = paste(over_agency, "vs", under_agency)) |>
    select(agency_combo, everything(), -over_agency, -under_agency) |>
    arrange(desc(arb_roi_pct))
})

performance_by_market <- reactive({
  summarise_performance(filtered_data(), "market_name") |>
    arrange(desc(arb_roi_pct))
})

daily_plot_data <- reactive({
  filtered_data() |>
    group_by(game_date) |>
    summarise(
      bets = n(),
      total_profit = sum(total_profit, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(game_date) |>
    mutate(cumulative_profit = cumsum(total_profit))
})
```

## Snapshot

```{r}
renderTable({
  summary_stats()
})
```

## Profit Trend

```{r}
renderPlot({
  df <- daily_plot_data()
  validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No rows match current filters."))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = game_date)) +
    geom_col(aes(y = total_profit), fill = "#7db3ff", alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_line(aes(y = cumulative_profit), color = "#1f5fbf", linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_point(aes(y = cumulative_profit), color = "#1f5fbf", size = 1.5) +
    labs(
      x = "Game Date",
      y = "Profit ($)",
      title = "Daily Profit (Bars) and Cumulative Profit (Line)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
})
```

## Performance By Date

```{r}
renderDT({
  df <- performance_by_date()
  validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No rows match current filters."))

  datatable(
    df,
    rownames = FALSE,
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 15,
      scrollX = TRUE,
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = c("copy", "csv")
    )
  ) |>
    formatRound(c("total_unders_profit", "total_unders_stake", "total_overs_profit", "total_overs_stake", "total_arb_profit", "total_stake"), 2) |>
    formatRound(c("unders_roi_pct", "overs_roi_pct", "arb_roi_pct"), 2)
})
```

## Filtered Bets

```{r}
renderDT({
  df <- filtered_data() |>
    select(
      game_date,
      match,
      player_name,
      market_name,
      line,
      over_agency,
      under_agency,
      margin,
      outcome,
      over_price,
      under_price,
      over_profit,
      under_profit,

    arrange(desc(game_date), desc(margin))

})
```
